name: Alt OI-flush beta (15m long, funding-negative confirms leveraged washout)
rationale: MECHANISM (H5 with a funding-negative arm replacing realized-vol): in an alt cascade the perps that flush hardest are exactly the ones where leverage was one-sided, and a deeply negative funding at the flush confirms the wiped-out crowd was over-levered (not a calm spot sell-off). Alt leverage over-shoots and the spot float anchors the snap-back. Counterparty: thin-book alt liquidation flow. SPOT long, funding accrues (we pay nothing while funding is negative). Entry: open_interest cross_down through a DEEP negative floor AND rsi below a low oversold floor AND ret_Nd below a negative floor (falling) AND funding_rate below a negative floor (leverage was one-sided). DISCONFIRMER: cross-asset ablation vs BTC-only — equal performance kills the 'alt idiosyncratic' thesis; per-symbol not pooled — an outlier-carried edge is an artifact; and drop the funding arm — no degradation means it added no leverage-confirmation. Must beat BH net of fees with alt-appropriate maxDD.
catalyst: deep alt OI flush + oversold + falling + negative funding — a one-sided leverage washout
